metadata.label: Ontario Science and Technology Grade 6 curriculum

ontario-science-g6-all-strands.documentTitle: Ontario Science and Technology Grade 6 - Overall Expectations

standards.summaryText: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures
standards.officialOutcomeText: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures

standards.summaryText: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields
standards.officialOutcomeText: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences

standards.summaryText: assess the importance of biodiversity, and describe ways of protecting biodiversity
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess the importance of biodiversity, and describe ways of protecting biodiversity
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of biodiversity, its contributions to the stability of natural systems, and its benefits to humans
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of biodiversity, its contributions to the stability of natural systems, and its benefits to humans

standards.summaryText: evaluate the impact of the use and generation of electrical energy on society and the environment, and suggest ways to use electrical energy responsibly
standards.officialOutcomeText: evaluate the impact of the use and generation of electrical energy on society and the environment, and suggest ways to use electrical energy responsibly
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the principles of electrical energy and its transformation into and from other forms of energy
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the principles of electrical energy and its transformation into and from other forms of energy

standards.summaryText: assess the environmental impacts of flying machines
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess the environmental impacts of flying machines
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the ways in which properties of air can be applied to the principles of flight and flying machines
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the ways in which properties of air can be applied to the principles of flight and flying machines

standards.summaryText: assess the impact of space exploration on humans, society, and the environment
standards.officialOutcomeText: assess the impact of space exploration on humans, society, and the environment
standards.curriculumFocus: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an understanding of the solar system, the phenomena that result from the movement of different bodies within it, and the technologies used in space exploration
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the solar system, the phenomena that result from the movement of different bodies within it, and the technologies used in space exploration
